findings.current: In a single night, the Embroidered Uniform Guard dragged away more than a hundred people.
findings.defect: The draft reduces hundreds of arrests to more than one hundred.
findings.rationale: 수백 명이 넘는 describes a count in the hundreds, not merely over one hundred.
findings.replacement: In a single night, the Embroidered Uniform Guard dragged away hundreds of people.
findings.source: 하룻밤 사이 수백 명이 넘는 이들이 금의위에 의해 끌려갔다.

findings.current: The one and only person in this vast realm who gave absolute loyalty to the Emperor.
findings.defect: The draft calls the Guard one person and reverses the point: the Emperor is the sole recipient of the Guard’s loyalty.
findings.rationale: 금의위 is the implied subject pledging loyalty; 오직 단 한 사람 identifies the Emperor.
findings.replacement: In this vast realm, they gave their absolute loyalty to one person alone: the Emperor.
findings.source: 이 광활한 천하에서 오직 단 한 사람. 황제에게 절대적인 충성을 바치는.

findings.current: No matter how much the Deputy Military Commissioner favors you
findings.defect: The draft changes 지휘사 into a deputy commissioner, altering the superior’s rank.
findings.rationale: 지휘사 denotes the commander here, not a deputy; the sentence invokes that superior’s favor.
findings.replacement: No matter how much the Guard Commander favors you
findings.source: 정 천호께서 제아무리 지휘사 영감의 총애를 받는다고 해도

findings.current: They had to produce results for their superiors—even if that meant killing the prisoners horribly or leaving them half-dead.
findings.defect: “Half-dead” changes the threatened outcome from disabling the prisoners to nearly killing them.
findings.rationale: 반병신으로 만들다 describes leaving someone severely disabled.
findings.replacement: They had to produce results for their superiors—even if that meant killing the prisoners horribly or leaving them half-crippled.
findings.source: 참혹하게 죽이거나, 반병신으로 만들어서라도 상부에 올려보낼 결과물을 만들어야 한다.

findings.current: “As daring as ever. Just like ten years ago.”
findings.defect: The draft makes an approximate interval of more than ten years exact.
findings.rationale: 십여 년 전 means a little over ten years ago.
findings.replacement: “As daring as ever. Just like a little over ten years ago.”

findings.current: “This banquet… could become a Hongmen Banquet.”
findings.defect: The untranslated historical allusion leaves the final warning’s implication unclear to an English reader.
findings.rationale: 홍문연 invokes a banquet used as cover for an attempt to kill a political rival; a brief note preserves the allusion without explaining it inside Hong Jin’s dialogue.
findings.replacement:
“This banquet… could become a Hongmen Banquet.[^1]”

[^1]: At the historical Feast at Hong Gate, a banquet became the setting for an attempt on Liu Bang’s life.
findings.source: “이번 연회가…… 홍문연(鴻門宴)이 될 수도 있겠네.”

summary: The draft changes a prisoner count, misidentifies who receives the Guard’s loyalty, and alters an official’s rank. It also softens an injury, loses a time cue, and leaves the closing historical allusion unexplained.
